The '''T-5RZ Onslaught Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was utilized by the [[Coronas]], a criminal gang that worked for the corrupt [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] politician [[Harmon Torvix]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the T-5RZ Onslaught Droid was destroyed in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces that salvaged the droid's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The final enemy of the Imperial mission "Asset Liquidation" in the Black Hole, the T-5RZ Onslaught Droid was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole Daily Area.<ref name="TOR" />

The mission log text for "Asset Liquidation" refers to the droid as the "T-5R7 Onslaught Droid." However, both the model and the name of the memory core refer to it as "T-5RZ."<ref name="TOR" />
